profile.name: Huynh Quang Tri Nguyen
profile.title: Bachelor of International Business / Master of Business Analytics

about: My name is Nguyen Huynh Quang Tri, also known as Bryan. I hold a Master’s degree in Business Analytics and a Bachelor’s degree in International Business from the University of Wollongong. Throughout my academic and professional journey, I am committed to applying data analytics to understand business development, improve performance, and facilitate strategic decisions.

I’ve had the opportunity to intern in both business development and marketing, where I worked with real-world data, CRM systems, campaign analysis, and customer insights. These experiences taught me how to combine strategic thinking with practical execution, collaborate with different teams, and adapt quickly in fast-paced environments.

I consider myself a curious and proactive learner. I’m passionate about solving problems, exploring ideas, and contributing to projects where data and creativity come together. Outside of work, I enjoy photography, discovering new cultures, and staying inspired through everyday learning.
